items: (c) Install the new bearing and oil seal.

content.description: Hands removing bearing with brass bar from pinion housing

items: (a) Remove the bearing with brass bar.

content.description: Hands removing teflon ring and O-ring from steering component

items: (a) Remove the teflon ring and O-ring.

content.description: Hands installing teflon ring to SST (Special Service Tool) on steering rack

content.text: (c) Install a new teflon ring to SST and install it to the steering rack.

content.description: Hands coating teflon ring with power steering fluid and sliding SST over tapered end

content.text: (d) Coat the teflon ring with power steering fluid and snug it down with your fingers.
(e) Carefully slide the tapered end of SST over the teflon ring to seat the ring.
NOTE: Make sure the seal is uniformly spaced around the perimeter of the piston.
